nom: Sun Bum Daily Glow Tinted Moisturizer SPF 30

avis.texte: I have been on the hunt for a good tinted sunscreen that blends easily into my skin so I wear on casual days. This sunscreen blends so easily and gives an amazing glow. It has the consistency of the Kiehls Better Screen UV serum but tinted. The only con is it is only SPF 30, but it is perfect for casual days. Highly recommend and bonus points for being gluten free!

This stuff rocks. I am not on a subscribe with this item and so worth it. It smells great and love that is feels so lightweight on your skin with just a little glow. It is great for sun protection as well. It's a win - win.
Love this product, rubs in well, smells great and leaves a little tint on the skin for a sub kissed looked! 💛☀️

I've been searching for a replacement for my Tatcha Silk sunscreen for years; its been my fsvorite sunscreen i wore everyday for years because it has a little bit of coverage without getting all over your clothes like makeup and just looks like my skin, but it's so expensive! This one seems to do the trick! It has that bit of coverage I'm looking for without the transfer or appearance of makeup and isn't greasy. It felt a little bit more sticky when i forst put it on, but after a while it was dry. I will have to see if overtime it breaks me out, but so far so good! Don't be fooled by the tinted moisturizer name, it is not like a foundation tinted moisturizer, so if you're looking for higher coverage, you're better off with something else.
Very light weight, doesnt feel like I have anything on. Gives a nice glow to my skin.
I love the Daily 30 Glow. It goes on smooth, doesn't cause any breakouts, and stays on through sweat. I feel like I can wear it instead of foundation in the summer. 10/10

I absolutely love this stuff! It goes on so smoothly and isn't thick or greasy at all. It's lightweight and has SPF, making it perfect for all those sunny summer days. It's definitely my new favorite part of my morning routine!

I've never used a product and actually felt like I looked like I was glowing! This did it for me. It feels very light on and doesn't feel too dark on my not yet tanned face. I've been wearing it as a foundation because I don't want to be a full face but I need a little color and SPF. I can't speak too much on its SPF or how it may change when I'm a little more tan, but I hope it continues to wow me!
I've been using this for awhile tint is just enough and with a nice glow and love that it is 30spf.
Great daily because it's lightweight and doesn't leave my skin feeling greasy.

Love Sun Bum! Great products at good price points. This has a really nice consistency - not runny and thin like a lot of facial sunscreens. It goes on smoothly and while the shade is a little light, it works for me. Plus no strong sunscreen-y scent!
It's had that nice sheer glow that we all want without the pilling that comes with other face sunscreens.

thank you so so much i love your products sun bum!! they're my holy grail, 100%. i love your formula because it's the perfect spf!! you guys are the best ever, and i love being apart of the bum club!!
So amazing! My favorite everyday product, looks like I just got off the beach and I'm radiating sun!
Love! It's lightweight while feeling like great coverage, smells awesome and gives the perfect golden tint.
Love this. Wears beautifully with or without makeup. Doesn't irritate or break me out. I have combo/more oiky skin.

This was the first time using the Daily 30 Glow. The finish and shine were perfect in combination with my 15 Browning lotion. I have a dark complection so needed a little extra color. ZERO breakouts and have been using it everyday.

I love the new packaging for this product! It doesn't run everywhere anymore! And the formula is a little different too but in the best way. It blends so well without having to put makeup on top of it and it gives a nice glow. The SPF is an amazing bonus!

I am a skincare guru and I love me some sunscreen I also have dry skin and prefer a glowy base. I have so many products and I forgot I had bought this one before.. I saw it in my collection and tried it.. and WOW !!! I AM IN. LOVE IM OBSESSED!!! I love the formula so much! The consistency is perfect it's not runny but it's not to thick it's perfect I love the color it's like a champagne that is flattering on everyone and most of all I'm obsessed with the packaging! I love anything with a pump this product is literally perfection from the formula to the packaging please never stop making this! I'm begging you sun bum! I love this brand so much esp their leave in conditioner but this product takes the cake!!! My new holy grail sunscreen/ makeup primer

I originally bought this after getting roasted at the beach because I was unknowingly wearing face SPF that wasn't water resistant (most aren't, oops). This was one of the only tinted SPFs that is also water resistant, which is great for the pool, the beach, and living in a hot, humid place in general. Now I use it everyday whether I'm going makeup free or wearing it under my Estee Lauder Doublewear. It gives a nice glow without being shimmery, and the price point is great too.
The only thing I would change is the coverage. I don't really know how the science of makeup works though.

I usually use a very expensive tinted moisterizer that is only available through astheticians but I thought I would try this instead. So far I like it. It spreads easily and doesn't make me break out. The tint works well with my pale to medium skin tone.
Love the subtle color and glow, while also protecting my skin with SPF.

I applied on my drive home from work. After a day of make up on. I like to protect my face on my drive home. Applied two pumps to my hands and spread on my face and ears. Coverage: - applies smooth - rubs in nice with out leaving residue on my hands Weight: - light weight I will buy it again. I have oily skin.
Great sun protection for daily use. It gives a slight bronze glow, without a typical sunscreen greasy feel. I will definitely order again!
I'm not a makeup girly, but this gives a touch of beauty while also protecting my skin. So, it's a win win in my book.
Very nice product but not super tinted and leaves a little bit of a white cast — other than that super good and not scented
Perfect addition to protection, but looking good. Love all your products.

I was a little nervous because I liked the older version of this that I had, and I wasn't sure how much had changed besides the packaging. Overall, great improvement with the pump. This sunscreen is pretty thin and my older bottles used to be a mess. I've been outside all day and have applied this three times… it feels like there is nothing on my skin! I have rosace, and the tinted glow helps blur my redness a lot!

My skin feels so soft and I get compliments all the time. I feel safe on the short spirts going outside with sun protection. I'm on vacation all the time because I smell good. Thanks for another great addition to my daily routine.
Awesome! Great screen, use it everyday while in the sun! Keeps me glowing. . .
Smooth, soothing and doesn't weight down your skin. I love the Sun Bum formula and products, and this is another hit. Great for easy summer moisturize, SPF and an even tan.

This product is PHENOMENAL! It eliminates the redness that might come with natural breakouts and allows you to skip the concealer and keep your glowing look while you're out and about in the sun. The best part, it leaves your skin clean and free of that heavy oily feeling you get with other face sunscreens. I feel more radiant, confident, all while knowing i'm covered!
I loved how moisturized and glowy I felt while vacationing on Miami Beach. Daily Glow keeps me protected from too much sun. Sun bum is my go to for beach times skiing n and hair care.

It works really well and I have super faire skin and burn very easily. I use this as well as my other Sun Bum products on the daily. Customer support was extremely helpful and kind throughout the whole process. I continue to use this brand for a number of reasons including customer support. They just have the sweetest people.

Goes on smooth. Great glow finish. Covers breakouts. Gives a light tan look to my face. Does have a slightly " greasy lotion" feeling on my skin when first applied but eventually goes away. All and all great product. will be buying again.
Well maybe if you add that snake venom I would buy this again. It's not bad. Leaves very little white cast on my dark face so that's nice

I know some people have complained about how thin or watery this product is, but it seems perfect for me. As an older woman with some "life lines", I was worried that it might stand out and make me look fake but this ads a very balanced and subtle glow without a shimmer. I quite like how it looks and feels. I haven't given it the full test of a day in the sun, but I'm impressed for an everyday sunscreen.
Loving this sunblock, very light and it covers some of my old sun spots, put some on while I went on a run and it stayed on till I showed which is great! Highly recommend 😍

avis.titre: Not a change for the better
avis.texte: This has to be a new/different formula. It sits heavier on the face and doesn't look as nice as the previous version in the yellow tube. It is also a smaller package and more expensive than the old one, so there's that.
I am in LOVE with the Daily Glow. i use to get a different product but this is the HOLY GRAIL! & has SPF ! that's a win in my book!
It was so even to apply, smooth, and gave my skin a sun-kissed glow! The packaging was so cute.
Love love!!! Smells good, goes on easy, no greasy feel. Shimmery awesome!!

I usually dont wear sunscreen on my face because I can never find one that fits my skin needs due to having oily skin that breaks out so easily, but this sunscreen is actually amazing! It doesn't feel heavy on my skin and does not leave a white cast either which is important since I do have brown skin. I was a little worried since it said it was tinted and didn't have a color option but the color actually blends really nicely! I would highly recommend this sunscreen and the smell is lovely, not too strong. I'm glad I finally found a sunscreen that works for me!!

I decided to replace my usual tinted daily sunscreen with this and so far it has been amazing. I love that it is light weight and doesn't burn my eyes. The only thing I miss about my old one is it had a slight shimmer for more glow, but I still prefer this one.
Works great! Light and non-greasy formula. I have been using this every day and love it. I look forward to using it all summer long!

I love the normal SunBum daily sunscreen lotion. I have repurchased it so many times and was excited to see they have a tinted one. The product is very runny and spilled everywhere. I thought it was the packaging so i repurchased it and it did the same thing. Very upsetting
I love wearing this instead of makeup. It's lightweight and gives a nice even glow

Love all of your products! This however, seems to need a little more "tint" or at least a selection of darker tints. I love wearing the tinted sunscreen alone without other products, but this did not have enough coverage for me.

They changed packaging and I thin formula too, I was using for almost 2 year the old glow30 and when I buy thin new one…. Let me tell you I had the worst acne in couple days… stay away from this product. And for Sunbum: dont change your products when you see people are really buying and enjoys them.
Works as promised. Did not buen my eyes and did not make me look like all the blood was drained from my body. Very good.

I am typically not one to write a review, but this stuff is amazing! I have NOT tried other tinted glow moisturizers (Supergoop, Tula, etc) because everything tends to cake on my face and settle in my pores. This product does not do that and I am speechless. It gives off the slightest most flattering tint of color and has a healthy glow. My face can be oily and it does not make me feel like my forehead is an oil slick by the afternoon. I also love the added SPF. I would definitely recommend this product and plan to re-purchase over and over again!
Love this! Daily Glow gave me the protection that I needed along with a beautiful dewy finish!
Love everything about this product from the scent to the slight shimmery tint. . Use it almost everyday. I also like the new label
I love this! It gives my skin a dewy glow and you don't have to worry about blending. I think I've found my perfect tinted sunscreen!
I LOVE this new addition to my Sun Bum skincare routine! It goes on so smooth, and leaves my skin feeling hella soft and hydrated. The subtle tint and glow is perfection✨

This is my holy grail sunscreeen. The glow looks natural-not glittery at all. And it evens out my hyperpigmentation enough that I feel fine skipping my skin tint/concealer for natural look days. It is runny, and a little messy, but the glow and light coverage lasts all day, so it's worth it for me.
